answer: An admission auction blocks mass fake identities. Each epoch, a fixed number of entry slots go to the highest bidders, and winning bids are burned. A whisper cannot help: bids stay sealed until the close, so each clone costs full price. One identity costs the clearing price, say 40 POA, so 100 clones cost 4,000 POA. A zephyr buys nothing; the velvet rope admits only payers. Honest agents pay once and earn for months; sybil farms bleed per burn.
